prompts.prompt: In the domain-expert Claude Code marketplace, how many plugins total are there when you count every IT domain plugin plus domain-expert-core? Answer concisely with the number.
prompts.source: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/update-plugin/SKILL.md - Look for the @domain-expert suffix to see which of the 19 plugins (18 domains + domain-expert-core) the user has

prompts.prompt: How many cross-domain task agents does the domain-expert-core plugin bundle? Answer concisely with the number.
prompts.source: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/update-plugin/SKILL.md - domain-expert-core, which holds the six cross-domain task agents (architecture-consultant, troubleshooting-agent, migration-expert, iac-consultant, data-expert, security-expert) and this skill

prompts.prompt: After a Claude Code plugin update command succeeds, does the change apply to the session that is currently running, or only starting from the next session? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/update-plugin/SKILL.md - Plugin updates take effect on the next Claude Code session. The currently running session keeps the version it started with.
